_comment: Brokered Graphiti front door. NO bearer in this file: the broker resolves GRAPHITI_MCP_TOKEN on its own side of the trust boundary and authenticates the session against its verifiable identity (ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md, capability carrier). When the broker URL is unset or the broker is not deployed this server returns an honest 401 and memory runs DEGRADED — never a reason to paste a token. Peer of environment/agents/adapters/claude-code/mcp.template.json.
